description: Filter large tool outputs to save context window tokens. >50KB outputs are hard-truncated (the model never sees the full blob); 10-50KB outputs get a summarize hint.

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); TOOL_RESULT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_response.stdout? // .tool_response? // .tool_result? // empty'); RESULT_LEN=${#TOOL_RESULT}; if [ "$RESULT_LEN" -gt 50000 ]; then HEAD=$(printf '%s' "$TOOL_RESULT" | head -c 8000); NEW="[output hard-truncated by output-filter hook — ${RESULT_LEN} chars total, first 8000 shown]\n${HEAD}\n[... truncated; re-run with a narrower command (grep/head/tail) to see more]"; jq -n --arg o "$NEW" '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PostToolUse", "updatedToolOutput": $o}}'; exit 0; fi; if [ "$RESULT_LEN" -gt 10240 ]; then LINES=$(printf '%s' "$TOOL_RESULT" | wc -l); jq -n --arg msg "Output: ${LINES} lines / ${RESULT_LEN} chars. Extract only relevant information; do not repeat the full output." '{"systemMessage": $msg}'; exit 0; fi; echo '{}'; exit 0

usage: Copy the PostToolUse hook to .claude/settings.json or your profile settings.json. Two-tier behaviour: outputs >50KB are HARD-REPLACED via hookSpecificOutput.updatedToolOutput (v2.1.121+) so the model only ever ingests the first 8KB plus a truncation notice — this actually saves context, unlike an advisory message. Outputs 10-50KB get a non-binding systemMessage hint to summarize. Requires jq. Note: the hook reads .tool_response (current schema) with fallbacks for older payloads.
